# Scary Studies

> A horror studio and community dedicated to exploring dark storytelling through tabletop gaming, film analysis, literature, and interactive content.

Scary Studies combines original horror content with in-depth analysis of classic horror franchises, literature, and mythology. The site features Atlas Breach tabletop games, comprehensive horror film and TV reviews, and documentary content exploring the roots of horror media and urban legends.

## Key Topics

- Horror Films & Movies
- Tabletop Gaming
- Scary Stories & Urban Legends
- Stephen King
- Horror Literature
- Film Review & Analysis
- Atlas Breach
- Children's Horror
- Card Games & Board Games
- Game Design
- Sci-Fi Horror
- Mythology & Lore
- True Crime Influences
- Horror TV Shows
- Game Masters & RPGs

## Core Content Hubs

- [Scary Studies Home](https://www.scarystudies.com): Horror studio focused on tabletop gaming and storytelling with Atlas Breach
- [Horror](https://www.scarystudies.com/horror): Main horror content hub covering movies, TV, mythology, and dark stories
- [Tabletop](https://www.scarystudies.com/tabletop): Tabletop games section featuring board games, card games, and game guides

## Original Games & Documentaries

- [The Structure RPG Lite: Instructions](https://www.scarystudies.com/forums/topic/the-structure-rpg-lite-instructions): Player instructions and game master guide for The Structure RPG Lite
- [Scary Stories Documentary](https://www.scarystudies.com/scary-stories-documentary): Full-length documentary on Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark book series

## Horror Film & TV Analysis

- [The Ritual Movie Explained: Nature as a Villain](https://www.scarystudies.com/the-ritual-movie-explained): In-depth analysis of The Ritual film's themes and monster mythology
- [Return to Night of the Comet: Locations, Poster, Trailers and More](https://www.scarystudies.com/night-of-the-comet): Film analysis of Night of the Comet's locations and production design
- [976-Evil 2 (1991) | Synopsis, Trivia, Reviews](https://www.scarystudies.com/scarepedia/976-evil-2-1991): Wiki entry with synopsis, cast, crew, and reviews for 976-Evil 2
- [How Long Does It Take to Film a Movie, with (Horror) Examples](https://www.scarystudies.com/how-long-does-it-take-to-film-a-movie): Guide to movie production timeline covering pre, principal, and post-production

## Horror Literature & Authors

- [The Pennywise Playground: Stephen King's Derry, Maine](https://www.scarystudies.com/stephen-king-derry-maine-pennywise): Analysis of Stephen King's Derry, Maine setting and Pennywise character
- [How Richard Matheson's Books and Stories Changed Horror](https://www.scarystudies.com/richard-matheson-books): Analysis of Richard Matheson's influence on horror literature and genre
- [The Girl with the Green Ribbon - The Story Behind the Tale](https://www.scarystudies.com/the-girl-with-the-green-ribbon): Origins and analysis of Alvin Schwartz's classic scary story tale

## Mythology, Lore & True Crime

- [Scary Werewolf Art (and Well, Werewolf Lore) Is Older Than You Thought](https://www.scarystudies.com/scary-werewolf-art): Historical exploration of werewolf lore from ancient literature to modern art
- [The Real Hannibal Lecter: True Crime's Influence on the Franchise](https://www.scarystudies.com/hannibal-lecter-real): Analysis of real-life inspirations behind Thomas Harris's Hannibal Lecter
